checks.name: Exact final source binding
checks.evidence: All120 declared pins exact;108 frozen production modules equal current repository/public; four prepared scripts AST parsed without importing/evaluating them.

checks.name: Independent scalar potential
checks.evidence: Reference imports only math/numpy; independently implements SO(3), interpolation, scalar potential and second-order AD. Product/unary rules and explicit elementary derivative self-check formulas reviewed.

checks.name: Explicit topology and literal masses
checks.evidence: Five explicit stations include Weight t=.5 and the shoulder at0. Four elements, material length .5 each; lower3kg,upper3.5kg,point2kg,total8.5kg. Ground/free acceleration constraints yield declared66/108network/dynamic dimensions.

checks.name: Structural and pylon offsets
checks.evidence: Left-side shoulder endpoint offset(-.15,0,-.07) relative to right-side structural node; point pylon(.20,.15,.23) from literal CG minus jig attachment. No mass or material length assigned to rigid shoulder.

checks.name: Material rotation and mass convention
checks.evidence: Distributed CG interpolation uses full material endpoint triads Qa*Rja/Qb*Rjb, matching material=True; point pylons use deformation Q. Mass uses original material ds and weight/input-g, never stretched ds.

checks.name: Potential sign and chart
checks.evidence: V=sum m*g*[Xz+(R_EB*xc)z]. DynamicSystem chart r=r0+L*ztranslation,Q=exp(zrotation)Q0, Earth position usesL, Euler usesrad; runner follows exact36-coordinate map.

checks.name: Same-state gravity isolation
checks.evidence: TimeSystem.gravity supplies R_EB.T*[0,0,-g] with condition=None. Off forcing changes only gravity_override; identical raw state/zero derivative. Other residual rows explicitly cancel; prescribed shape is not claimed equilibrium.

checks.name: Row normalization
checks.evidence: Nodal/global force residuals multiply by actual F, moments by F*L. On-minus-off gives positive physical gravity load; comparison is with negative potential gradient. Source network/OperatingSystem row contracts checked.

checks.name: Virtual-work pullbacks
checks.evidence: Earthforce R*F; global moment moved from reference to origin by+rref cross F, then EulerE.T; local spatial moments pulled back by Jleft(eta).T. Reciprocity is imposed on coordinate covectors, not raw torque arrays.

checks.name: Pre-residual geometry guards
checks.evidence: Before first residual, checks nodes, original material lengths, structural offsets, endpoint material frames,5nodes4elements6ground constraints0Gamma6operatingrows; geometry gate2e-12abs+rel.

checks.name: Derivative width and quadrature policy
checks.evidence: Frozen centered widths1e-4/5e-5; directions at most.1rad so actualrotation<=1e-5. Both widths compare independently to same-H*d, and to each other at2e-8abs+rel. Baseline8/16/32 value/gradient/Hessian use that same gate, not a stronger quadrature certificate.

checks.name: Distinct local/mixed invariants
checks.evidence: Full36covector at29states;7Hessian directions; headingzero; shape totalforce derivativezero; centroid resultants/origin covariance;6mixed frame-shape reciprocal scalars and required nonzero mixed coupling.

checks.name: Finite operations and raw retention
checks.evidence: 58R=2baseline+7directions*4signedprobes*2gravity;31potentials=3baselineH+28firstorder;7small Hessian-direction products. Raw packets saved before gates. No trim/fulllinearization/harmonic solve/retry.

checks.name: Owned process and permitted algebra
checks.evidence: Exclusive launch guard; one single-thread Python-I-B child cap60s, terminate/kill/reap. Local<=3 solve/inv/eigen algebra allowed/recorded; quadrature/import fixedtables<=64. No full-system factorization requested.
